footer.tagline: A cheerful riddle game: the riddle gets clearer.
footer.note: Your progress stays on this device.

header.stars: {count} stars. See what you can unlock

welcome.title: Welcome to Hanglet
welcome.text: A playful riddle game for everyone from 8 years old. Let's set it up for you.

tour.label: Quick tour
tour.word: This is the hidden word. Every tile is one letter.
tour.picture: Look at the picture and read Tilo's clue. They help you find the word!
tour.keyboard: Tap a letter to guess. Try one now!
tour.goodGuess: Nice! That letter is in the word.
tour.wrongGuess: That letter is not in the word. No problem, keep trying!
tour.figure: Every wrong letter costs a heart. Find the word before your hearts run out!
tour.hintsFree: Stuck? Tap Help and Tilo will help you.
tour.kidsKeyboard: Only these letters! Tap one to try.
tour.clues: These are Tilo's clues. The first one is tricky! After every 2 wrong letters a clearer clue opens. The sooner you solve it, the more stars.
tour.knowIt: Know the word? Tap here and type it. A wrong word costs 2 lives.

setup.classicIntro: Pick your options and solve as many riddles as you like.

play.letterWrong: {letter} is not in the word. {count} lives left.
play.freeLetter: Easy: the first letter is a gift.
play.lockedHard: Not on Hard. You're on your own!
play.lastLives: Careful: you only have {count} lives left.
play.wrongLength: The word has {count} letters. Try again, this one is free.
play.noChallengeClue: Your friend didn't add a clue. Good luck!

daily.comeBack: Come back tomorrow for new riddles

classic.title: Classic
classic.subtitle: Endless riddles, one after another
classic.text: Endless riddles. You pick the category.

levels.title: Levels
levels.text: 40 levels on a map, from easy to tough.

kids.title: Kids world
kids.subtitle: Short words with a picture
kids.text: For ages 6–9. Easy, funny clues and a picture.

challenge.title: Challenge a friend
challenge.text: Pick a secret word, write 3 clues, send the link.

kids.intro: Short words with a picture and funny clues. Tilo helps you, and every word gives you a sticker!
kids.hello: Hi! Shall we find some words together?
kids.stickerAgain: You have this sticker {count} times now
kids.tryOther: Not in this word. Try another letter!
kids.fill: I'll help you: here comes the {letter}!
kids.forParents: For parents: no stars, no clock and you can't lose. Words have 3 to 5 letters, always with a picture and 3 easy clues. After a wrong letter an easier clue appears and Tilo helps.

share.classic: I solved a {count}-letter riddle in Hanglet at clue {number}!
share.title: Share your result
share.imageAlt: Your result as a picture, without the word

levels.title: Level map
levels.intro: Every level has a few riddles. Solve them all to open the next level. The more stars per riddle, the more stars for the level.
levels.failedText: One riddle missed. Try the level again, you can do it!

home.title: Today's riddles
home.speechReady: I have three new riddles for you!
home.speechDone: Well done! Up for more riddles?
home.dailyReady: Three new riddles, the same for everyone.

dictionary.title: My dictionary
dictionary.intro: Every word you solved, with Tilo's 3 clues. The yellow one is where you got it.
dictionary.empty: Your dictionary is still empty. Solve a word to add it here.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.intro: Everything you have done so far. Saved on this device only.
stats.chartTitle: At which clue did you solve it?
stats.chartEmpty: Solve a riddle to see your chart.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Make Hanglet look, sound and feel the way you like.
settings.kidsFirstHelp: Puts the Kids world at the top of the home page
settings.themesHelp: Earn stars to unlock new themes.
settings.figuresHelp: Choose what happens on the board. Earn stars to unlock new figures.
settings.soundHelp: Short tones for right and wrong letters
settings.vibrationHelp: Buzz on a wrong letter (phones only)
settings.dataHelp: Your progress is saved in this browser only. Download it as a file to keep it safe or to move it to another device.
settings.resetText: This removes your stars, streaks, badges, levels, dictionary and settings. Tip: download your progress first.
settings.musicHelp: Cheerful, bouncy music while you play
settings.difficultyHelp: For the Daily, Classic and Levels. New players start on Easy.
settings.importText: The progress in the file replaces everything on this device: stars, streaks, badges, levels, dictionary and settings.
settings.importFailed: This is not a Hanglet progress file.

index.title: Hanglet – The riddle gets clearer
index.description: Tilo gives you a tricky clue, and every mistake makes the riddle clearer. Three new riddles every day, 40 levels and a Kids world for ages 6 to 9. Free, in English and Dutch.

play.title: Play – Hanglet
play.description: Read Tilo's clues and find the word. The riddle gets clearer with every mistake.

levels.title: Level map – Hanglet
levels.description: Follow the map through 40 Hanglet levels with more riddles as you climb.

dictionary.title: My dictionary – Hanglet
dictionary.description: Every word you solved in Hanglet, with its 3 clues.

badges.title: Badges – Hanglet
badges.description: Collect all Hanglet badges and see how close you are to the next one.

stats.title: Statistics – Hanglet
stats.description: Your riddles, stars, streaks and Daily calendar in Hanglet.

settings.title: Settings – Hanglet
settings.description: Language, difficulty, colors, figure, text size, sound and your progress file in Hanglet.

challenge.description: Pick a secret word, write 3 clues, send the link and see if your friend can solve it.

how-to-play.title: How to play – Hanglet
how-to-play.description: How Hanglet works: 3 clues, stars, "I know it!", difficulty and modes.

about.title: About – Hanglet
about.description: About Hanglet, a cheerful riddle game for everyone from 8, with a Kids world for ages 6 to 9.

privacy.title: Privacy – Hanglet
privacy.description: No account and no cookies. Your progress stays on your device.

kids.title: Kids world – Hanglet
kids.description: The Hanglet Kids world for ages 6 to 9: short words with a picture, funny clues, help from Tilo, no losing and stickers to collect.
